CommunityApplications.Profile:
**dmOffice** - a self-hosted, Outlook-like office suite: mail, calendar, contacts, tasks, notes and files with its own CalDAV, CardDAV and WebDAV server and an encrypted database per user.
This repository holds the Unraid template; the project itself is at https://github.com/Taloan/dmOffice and the image is built to `ghcr.io/taloan/dmoffice`. Questions and bug reports: GitHub issues or the support thread on the Unraid forum.
